document.abstract: It is well known that optical aberrations are unavoidable in lens systems and that the suitability of a lens for a particular application is dependent on the extent of these aberrations and the manner in which they are balanced. The optical requirements for television can be well defined and it is worth while to design lenses specifically for television purposes. The advantages so obtained can only be expressed qualitatively by test methods which are based on these special requirements.
